trigger_or_entry_point: Histological diagnosis and initial care planning
patient_caregiver_actions: Attend diagnostic visits; undergo surgery where feasible and chemoradiation
clinical_practice_actions: Neurosurgery, neuropathology, radiation oncology and neuro-oncology establish diagnosis and initial treatment plan
manufacturer_or_support_role: No device-specific action assumed at this stage
payer_or_access_gate: No device authorization assumed at this stage
likely_friction: Clinical status and recovery may affect later suitability
evidence_basis: Optune Gio HCP indication page; current product information
interpretation_caveat: This journey map focuses on newly diagnosed GBM and does not imply all patients are candidates

trigger_or_entry_point: Completion of radiation therapy with concomitant standard chemotherapy
patient_caregiver_actions: Discuss maintenance treatment choices and practical implications
clinical_practice_actions: Review disease status, imaging, performance status, label fit and treatment preferences
manufacturer_or_support_role: May provide HCP information; no clinical decision role
payer_or_access_gate: Check applicable payer timing and criteria before submission
likely_friction: Referral or decision delay can consume a payer-specific initiation window
proposed_metric: Days from completion of chemoradiation to treatment discussion
evidence_basis: CMS LCD L34823; Optune Gio HCP indications
evidence_type: CMS policy and manufacturer label description
interpretation_caveat: Medicare DME MAC timing rule is not universal across payers

trigger_or_entry_point: Clinician considers Optune Gio plus TMZ where appropriate
patient_caregiver_actions: Assess daily-use burden, scalp preparation, array changes, device logistics and caregiver capacity
clinical_practice_actions: Explain potential benefits, risks, alternatives and follow-up; assess readiness
manufacturer_or_support_role: Patient education and resource materials may be offered
payer_or_access_gate: Financial feasibility and benefit requirements should be discussed
likely_friction: Burden or financial responsibility may be underestimated
proposed_metric: Proportion of discussed patients who proceed to prescription; patient-reported readiness
evidence_basis: Optune Gio patient instructions and MyNovocure resources
interpretation_caveat: No independent real-world readiness or refusal rate identified

clinical_practice_actions: Manufacturer describes practice certification with a Territory Manager
manufacturer_or_support_role: Provides in-person or online practice certification
payer_or_access_gate: Not a payer criterion in itself
likely_friction: Staff unfamiliarity or unclear task ownership
proposed_metric: Staff certification completion; time to first complete submission
interpretation_caveat: Do not describe this as an FDA licensing requirement

trigger_or_entry_point: Patient and clinician decide to proceed
patient_caregiver_actions: Provide insurance details and participate in record collection
clinical_practice_actions: Submit prescription form, insurance card, history and physical, clinical notes and recent MRI with and without contrast
manufacturer_or_support_role: Receives submission and initiates support workflow
likely_friction: Missing imaging, notes or insurance data cause rework
proposed_metric: First-pass complete submission rate; days to submission
interpretation_caveat: Required packet may differ by insurer and plan

clinical_practice_actions: Respond to clinical documentation requests; track authorization
manufacturer_or_support_role: Benefits investigation followed by insurance authorization; Financial Coordinator welcome call described within 72 hours of approval
payer_or_access_gate: Coverage, prior authorization, exclusions and cost sharing are payer-specific
likely_friction: Denials, appeals, high cost sharing and delays
proposed_metric: Approval/denial/appeal rates; time to decision; estimated patient liability
evidence_basis: Optune Gio HCP MyNovocure workflow; Week 10 cost/access analysis
evidence_type: Manufacturer workflow plus prior project analysis
interpretation_caveat: Authorization does not mean zero out-of-pocket cost

clinical_practice_actions: Coordinate start appointment and review patient-specific array map
manufacturer_or_support_role: Array layout/map sent to practice before start appointment
payer_or_access_gate: Start must remain within any applicable payer-specific initiation window
proposed_metric: Approval-to-start interval; proportion within coverage window
evidence_basis: Optune Gio HCP MyNovocure workflow; CMS LCD L34823
interpretation_caveat: No public independent time-to-start distribution identified

patient_caregiver_actions: Patient/caregiver attends training and practices setup
clinical_practice_actions: Ensure clinician remains responsible for medical decisions and treatment advice
manufacturer_or_support_role: Device Support Specialist delivers to home or practice and provides live training
payer_or_access_gate: Supply and service availability must be coordinated
likely_friction: Training comprehension, caregiver capacity, access to home support
evidence_basis: Optune Gio HCP MyNovocure; Instructions for Use
evidence_type: Manufacturer-described service workflow and user instructions
interpretation_caveat: MyNovocure is technical/support service, not a substitute for medical advice

patient_caregiver_actions: Wear device an average target of 18 hours/day; manage four arrays, scalp care and device/battery routine
clinical_practice_actions: Assess medical concerns, skin reactions, tolerability and ongoing appropriateness
manufacturer_or_support_role: 24/7 technical support and supply reordering described
payer_or_access_gate: Some policies require objective use documentation
likely_friction: Scalp irritation, daily burden, equipment or supply interruption
proposed_metric: Average daily wear-time; supply interruptions; skin adverse events
evidence_basis: Optune Gio Quick Start Guide; Scalp Care Brochure; CMS LCD
interpretation_caveat: Patient materials are not independent evidence of adherence or treatment effectiveness

patient_caregiver_actions: Use technical help; attend clinical follow-up; request supplies as needed
clinical_practice_actions: Review disease status, adverse effects and treatment feasibility
manufacturer_or_support_role: Monthly check-ins and HCP progress tracking via MyLink described
payer_or_access_gate: Maintain authorization and documentation as required
likely_friction: Medical questions may be misdirected to technical support
proposed_metric: Monthly check-in completion; response time; unresolved support issues
interpretation_caveat: The HCP page says MyNovocure cannot provide medical advice

trigger_or_entry_point: Approaching three months after start under Medicare LCD
patient_caregiver_actions: Attend reassessment and continue recording device use
clinical_practice_actions: Conduct in-person reassessment and document ongoing use and benefit
manufacturer_or_support_role: May provide usage-related data to the practice
payer_or_access_gate: Medicare LCD requires reassessment between day 60 and day 91 and objective adherence evidence for continuation beyond first three months
likely_friction: Missed reassessment or incomplete documentation can affect coverage
proposed_metric: Reassessment completion; objective adherence documentation rate
evidence_type: CMS DME MAC local coverage policy
interpretation_caveat: Not a universal requirement for every insurer, payer or country

trigger_or_entry_point: Clinical reassessment, progression, adverse event or patient choice
patient_caregiver_actions: Discuss whether treatment remains feasible and acceptable
clinical_practice_actions: Make medical decisions; document reason for continuation, hold or stop
manufacturer_or_support_role: Support transition and technical closure where applicable
payer_or_access_gate: Coverage and supply may need renewal or closure
likely_friction: Progression, burden, toxicity, preference, financial or logistical issues
evidence_basis: CMS LCD; Optune Gio safety information
evidence_type: Payer policy and manufacturer safety information
interpretation_caveat: No independent population-level discontinuation dataset identified

trigger_or_entry_point: Treatment considered in a different healthcare system
clinical_practice_actions: Check national guidance and local pathways
manufacturer_or_support_role: Commercial launch information may be available but is not sufficient alone
payer_or_access_gate: Verify authorization, guideline position, reimbursement and site availability separately
likely_friction: A device may be authorized but not recommended or funded
proposed_metric: Share of jurisdictions with verified authorization, recommendation, coverage and service availability
evidence_basis: NICE NG99; UK Parliament answer 16 Jun 2026
interpretation_caveat: UK example cannot be generalized to all European or other markets
